message: Looking at it. product-service memory is at 93%. Looks like it's about to OOM.
Pod restarted but memory is climbing fast again. Something is leaking. Checking recent changes.
We enabled the 'extended_cache' feature flag this morning. It caches full product catalogs per-tenant. Could that be it?
Heap dump shows the cache is holding ~1.4GB of ProductCatalog objects. There's no TTL or max-size set on the extended cache. It just grows unbounded.
That's the bug. The regular cache has TTL and eviction. The extended cache was a quick prototype — eviction wasn't implemented yet.
Toggling the feature flag off now. That should stop the bleeding.
Flag is off, cache cleared. Memory stable at 320MB. Crisis over.
I'll add TTL and max-size to the extended cache before we re-enable the flag. Should have done that from the start.
